top:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE production-ready Tiger II Henschel tank game sprite from the user's exact top-view blueprint. Image 1 is geometry authority, image 2 supports surface understanding, image 3 is ONLY a style example for simplified strategy sprites, NOT geometry. Strict orthographic 90-degree top-down, front and long 88mm gun pointing LEFT. Reproduce the blueprint silhouette and proportions closely: wide rectangular hull with FULL covered track fenders, tapering sloped upper hull, turret front narrower than rear and distinctive angular six-sided Henschel turret, curved inner roof boundary, narrow mantlet and long slender gun with SMALL two-chamber muzzle brake. Turret layout matches blueprint precisely: large commander cupola in LOWER central/right roof, rectangular loader hatch above it, little roof fittings in their actual positions. Rear deck two circular cooling fan grilles above/below central engine covers, rectangular slatted grilles beside fans. Front driver/radio hatches beneath gun shoulders. Keep turret and hull dimensions at exact blueprint scale; gun must project forward far beyond hull.
Art treatment: attractive crisp hand-drawn 2D strategy game sprite, flat COOL medium German gray paint, thick clean dark outer outline and readable inner lines, a few deliberate cel-shaded light/dark regions, subtle edge highlights. Mechanical shapes carefully drawn; simplified medium-sized details like style example, clean non-noisy flat fills, no weathering texture. Avoid photoreal metal, exaggerated bevels, embossed plates, cartoon toy shapes, fake raised blocks, huge bolts. No need to copy black pen noise or watermark of references. Whole vehicle on genuine transparent background, close crop with small margin, no cast shadow, no perspective, no text. Planned hull length 200px; render high-resolution master with structure readable after downsampling.
hull: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this EXACT chosen top-down Tiger II drawing to create the HULL ONLY layer. Remove the ENTIRE turret, mantlet, gun, muzzle brake and every gun/turret cast shadow. Expose plain gray sloping hull roof with round empty dark turret ring centered exactly at (1150,441) on the original 1774x887 canvas, ring outer diameter approximately 360 pixels. Preserve ALL existing outer hull geometry, two front hatches, side tools/fenders, rear fans/grilles/covers, contours, crisp flat gray drawing and their exact positions. Fill formerly occluded roof conservatively in same gray style, no invented hatches, no ring illumination. Do not change camera, color or scale. Exact same 1774x887 transparent canvas as input; hull stays x~516..1752 and y~122..762; leave left former gun area TRANSPARENT. No barrel traces, floating parts, no text. Keep hull completely unchanged outside removed turret area.
turret: Use case: background-extraction. Isolate ONLY the existing Henschel turret plus its mantlet, long barrel and small muzzle brake from this EXACT chosen top-down Tiger II drawing. Remove the entire hull, tracks/fenders/tools/front hatches/rear engine deck. Preserve original turret silhouette, gray cel-shading, roof details and gun pixels faithfully, including asymmetrical commander cupola and upper loader hatch. Do not redraw, alter proportions, add parts, enlarge or recenter. Keep exact original 1774x887 canvas and original object location. The turret extends approximately x=875..1474 y=232..655, gun x=29..875 around y=438. Everything else must be genuinely transparent including ring/hull shadows. No ground, shadows, text.
hullCleanup: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix the hull-only sprite: remove the leftover six-sided turret footprint/diagonal turret silhouette seams and ALL the small turret attachment hooks scattered around that footprint. They belong to removed turret and must NOT appear on the hull when the turret rotates. Upper hull roof should be a single plain medium-gray flat plate bounded by actual side deck rails at y~225 and y~655, from behind the front hatches x~895 to before engine deck x~1430. Keep central turret ring exactly unchanged, preserve front hatches, every side tool/rail and engine deck. Do not add diagonal polygonal seams, raised turret-shaped plating, any hooks or gun traces. Preserve original silhouette, pixels outside upper central roof, scale, same 1774x887 canvas and genuine transparency. Clean simple cel-shaded gray roof, no texture, no extra parts.
destroyed: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create wreck state of THIS EXACT selected hull sprite. Keep exact 1774x887 canvas, every hull edge, hatch, side fender/tool, fan and engine deck in the identical location and scale. Modify only two local regions: central turret ring has a jagged breached black interior with several clearly bent rim sections; rear engine deck has two large localized dark scorched breaches and broken grilles. Most hull stays same clean medium gray and same brightness, especially front and side fenders. Crisp simplified 2D line-art/cel shading like source, a few big readable damage shapes, no realistic textures, no micro-shrapnel. No turret, gun, flames, smoke, debris outside silhouette, ground, external shadows or text. Genuine transparency. Do NOT zoom, enlarge, stretch, move or redraw outer hull. Source geometry is invariant.
